snippet.title: Exploria - Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer of Exploria, an RPG game made by Maghilux LTD.

We are 2 game developers with a crazy passion for videogames. This is our first game ever published for PCs, we hope you like our work.

For more, please visit:

https://www.maghilux.com/

Thank you!
